registration_timing: after loop_schedule_algebra_v0_1 outcomes and before R32 or R64 outcomes
claim_scope: functional-form discrimination for terminal visit alignment in the frozen small-scale tied residual-loop family; no task-performance, sample-efficiency, general Transformer, or general stability claim

saturating_exponential.fit_method: for each deterministic tau-grid value solve ordinary least squares for K and A, retain A>=0 and K>=max(observed kappa), then minimize SSE
saturating_exponential.tie_break: smallest tau, then smallest K, then smallest A

logarithmic.fit_method: ordinary least squares constrained to b>=0

fit_uncertainty.method: independent seed bootstrap within each R followed by geometric mean and complete model refit

discriminator.endpoint: absolute prediction error on the R64 tied geometric-mean kappa

saturation_support_rule.interpretation: all criteria are jointly required; otherwise bounded saturation remains unestablished

untied_flatness_control.pass_rule: the seed-bootstrap gamma interval contains zero and abs(point gamma)<=0.1

derived_metrics.power_law: reported as a legacy descriptive diagnostic only; excluded from the R64 model discriminator
derived_metrics.asymptotic_threshold: if kappa is bounded, local effective gamma tends to zero and the DeepLoop threshold expression tends toward p=1/4

claim_boundary: Bounded kappa would remove the additional alignment exponent asymptotically, but does not by itself remove the explicit R_g factor in B(A); this protocol cannot claim that total depth-dependent stability cost vanishes.

stop_branches.on_estimator_instability: stop the affected regime and retain raw traces
stop_branches.on_invalid_model_fit: seal model_fit_failure and do not expose R64
stop_branches.on_resource_failure: seal resource failure; do not reinterpret as geometric evidence

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
resources.chunk_strategy: one rounds-by-regime-by-seed training cell at a time
resources.checkpoint_interval: terminal 4096 state-visit exposures for every new cell
